messages:
tom_sales: Quick flag — Velocity Analytics POC is blocked. Customer hit two blockers: EU data residency confirmation and a ~20% pricing delta for committed throughput. They asked for an exec sync if we can't resolve by EOD.

sara_ae: timeline? they want a decision today? :grimacing:

john_eng: what specifically on data residency? do they need on-prem or just EU-hosted control plane?

tom_sales: they said "data cannot leave EU" and want logs + model telemetry stored in an EU region. POC currently runs in us-west.

elaine_infra: we have a EU-hosted private deployment option but it'd need a quick contract + infra spin up. estimated 3 business days to fully provision with KMS, can we shorten?

mike_product: for pricing: they're comparing to competitor X who offers flat committed nodes pricing. They want committed throughput pricing that drops our per-token by ~20% for a 12-month commit.

legal_amy: I can fast-track an addendum for EU data residency if they sign enterprise terms, need SOW specifics. Can someone confirm required retention and log types?

tom_sales: retention ask: request logs + telemetry for 90 days, no backups leaving region. Also they want SOC2 audit artifacts accessible.

john_eng: SOC2 artifacts we can share; telemetry parity ok. For POC we can spin a private instance in our eu-central region but it'll be constrained capacity-wise. We can do a temporary scoped private deployment for the POC.

elaine_infra: action: I can provision a small EU dedicated pool for POC (~2xA10 equivalent) and wire KMS in 24 hours if legal signs off. Need billing owner to approve temporary spend.

sara_ae: @cecilia_vp can you approve the temporary capacity spend? It's ~€4k for 24-48h to unblock the exec meeting.

cecilia_vp: on it — can we get a one-pager for cost vs deal ARR so I can sign off quickly?

tom_sales: rough deal math: ARR ~$360k if they convert after POC. Approve for me to attach the one-pager?

mike_product: i'll draft a one-pager: include committed throughput options (3 tiers) and show our fallback plan (quantized variant to lower cost).

legal_amy: I'll draft the residency addendum and mark it "POC temp". Sending for review in 1h.

ops-bot: Incident: EU provisioning capacity request queued — ticket #PROV-4821 created by elaine_infra. ETA: 36 hours (accelerated).

john_eng: note: to avoid rework for customer, we'll use the same model weights (no quantize) during POC. If they request lower cost production, we can present quantized options in pricing.

sara_ae: customer asked for exec call at 3pm CET. Can we commit to EU provision + legal addendum before that?

elaine_infra: 3pm CET is tight. I can have infra ready for a demo endpoint by 7pm CET if legal ok. If exec call at 3pm we should do a triage call to explain timeline and show commitment.

cecilia_vp: ok — we'll do a 3pm CET triage with their CTO and schedule a follow-up deep-dive for 7pm CET demo. @tom_sales please send calendar invite.

tom_sales: sending invites now. attendees: Velocity CTO, Sara, John, Elaine, Mike, Cecilia, Legal.Amy.

mike_product: prepping a 5-slide deck: POC scope, data residency steps, pricing tiers, rollback/fallback, next steps. Will post link here when ready.

legal_amy: posting draft addendum here: https://redwood.share/proposals/vel-residency-draft-v1 (please review inline comments).

john_eng: quick technical note for triage: show we can route customer traffic to EU model runtime, KV cache stays in-region, and we can exclude non-EU telemetry. Simple diag to show in triage.

sara_ae: Velocity says execs are sensitive to timeline — if we can commit to a 48h demo endpoint they're much more likely to sign.

cecilia_vp: approve temporary spend. Elaine proceed with provisioning. LegalAmy, please prioritize the addendum. Tom, own customer comms.

tom_sales: thanks. I'll tell them we have exec approval and that legal + infra are fast-tracking.

ops-bot: Ticket PROV-4821 updated: capacity allocation in progress. Estimated readiness: 2025-11-04T19:00:00Z (approx).

mike_product: deck link: https://redwood.docs/velocity-poc-deck-v1 (added talking points).

sara_ae: prepping the call script. Key asks for the execs: 1) agree to sign POC addendum, 2) confirm committed throughput intent, 3) pick a pricing tier.

tom_sales: will run runbook on call. Thanks all — i'll post notes after triage. :pray:
